verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page lists "Full accounts payable" as a managed service, and its bookkeeping page mentions real-time account data in the portal. Neither documents an AP aging report or point-in-time vendor balances. Keeping an existing QuickBooks account is a host-platform capability, and the general reporting and AP-service claims are adjacent features, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
